Apply.title: Köşk application
Changes.note: “Başvuruyu gönder” saves what you wrote as an application to open a köşk, and it waits for Medaris management’s decision. The Medaris başnazımı and the Medaris nazımları given that permission see it with your e-mail address and phone; every look at your contact details is written to the audit log. You can neither change nor withdraw an application once sent; you see the decision in your notifications, with the reason if it is refused.
